basic.name: 普通攻击：炽焰直调式
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：灼热熟成法
special.nameEn: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动一次火焰冲击，造成火属性伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting Fire DMG;
Press and hold [Special Attack] to charge, boosting the move's power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用单手喷射器持续喷射火焰，随后向前方直线范围发动一次火焰冲击，造成大量火属性伤害，保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长喷射的持续时间；
持续喷射期间拖曳摇杆，可以发动侧身闪避，向对应方向调整身位；
持续喷射期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低60%；
侧身闪避和火焰冲击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the joystick to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 60%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

dodge.name: 闪避：焰影疾行
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：危险发酵式
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
挥舞喷射器向前方进行突进攻击，造成火属性伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a forward rush attack with the flamethrower, dealing Fire DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：摇荡闪
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击并喷射火焰，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：燃油熔焰
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速突进并向周身喷射火焰，随后向前方扇形范围发动一次火焰冲击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Quickly dash forward while spraying flames in all directions, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

ultimate.name: 终结技：纵享盛焰
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速突进后跃向空中，对前方大范围区域持续喷射火焰，造成大量火属性伤害；
跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，柏妮思会延长火焰喷射的持续时间；
招式发动时，回复50点[燃点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.
Upon activation, recover 50 Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：提神特饮
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击并喷射火焰，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：烟熏油盅
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：灼焰甘露
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起，快速旋转前进并向周身喷射火焰，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

fields.text: 队友触发12次[余烬]后，柏妮思获得一点[流火]，拥有[流火]时，柏妮思下一次换入前场时消耗一点[流火]自动发动该招式，该次入场视作以[快速支援]入场，[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]触发的[余烬]命中敌人时增加2次计数，拥有[流火]时不再增加计数，消耗[流火]时清空计数；
fields.textEn: After squadmates trigger Afterburn 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of Emberflow. With Emberflow, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When Afterburn triggered by Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing Emberflow, the counter no longer increases. Consuming Emberflow clears the counter.

fields.text: 跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，柏妮思会延长火焰喷射的持续时间；
fields.textEn: When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.

fields.text:
柏妮思消耗能量值时，会为自身累积[燃点]，最多累积100点；每消耗1点能量值，能够累积1.4点[燃点]，当[燃点]累积至50点时，柏妮思将进入[燃油特调]状态，直到[燃点]耗尽；进入战场时，柏妮思立刻累积100点[燃点]；
[燃油特调]状态下，柏妮思的[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]、[连携技：燃油熔焰]或[终结技：纵享盛焰]命中敌人时，将对目标施加[灼伤]效果，直到柏妮思退出[燃油特调]状态；队伍中其他角色攻击命中处于[灼伤]状态下的敌人时，会触发[余烬]效果，消耗8点[燃点]，对目标造成等同于柏妮思350%攻击力的火属性伤害并累积火属性异常积蓄值，1.5秒内最多触发一次；每拥有10点异常精通，[余烬]效果造成的伤害提升1%，最多提升30%；[余烬]效果造成的伤害被视为[支援攻击]伤害。
fields.textEn:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 350% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

fields.text:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
柏妮思[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]命中敌人，或触发[余烬]效果时，招式累积的火属性异常积蓄值提升65%；队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[灼烧]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method or EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

basic.descriptionEn:
In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of Afterburn that doesn't cost Heat and deals Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as Assist Attack DMG.
Upon activation, it consumes 20 Heat.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

招式重击命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次原属性异常480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24%的伤害；
[额外能力：星火燎原]的火属性异常积蓄值提升效果对该招式生效；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
ex.descriptionEn:
If Burnice has Emberflow, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger Afterburn 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of Emberflow. With Emberflow, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When Afterburn triggered by Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing Emberflow, the counter no longer increases. Consuming Emberflow clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The Fire Anomaly Buildup increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

ultimate.name: 终结技：纵享盛焰
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速突进后跃向空中，对前方大范围区域持续喷射火焰，造成大量火属性伤害；
跃向空中时，将触发[快速支援]，若响应[快速支援]，柏妮思会延长火焰喷射的持续时间；
招式发动时，回复50点[燃点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.
Upon activation, recover 50 Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：提神特饮
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续攻击并喷射火焰，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

fields.name: 普通攻击：炽焰直调式
fields.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

fields.name: 普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式
fields.trigger: [燃油特调]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
[燃油特调]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
持续回旋并向周身喷射火焰，随后发动终结一击，额外触发一次不消耗[燃点]的[余烬]，造成火属性伤害，保持长按可以延长喷射的持续时间；
招式造成的伤害同时视为[支援攻击]伤害；
招式发动时，将会消耗20点[燃点]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
终结一击发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
fields.descriptionEn:
In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of Afterburn that doesn't cost Heat and deals Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as Assist Attack DMG.
Upon activation, it consumes 20 Heat.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

fields.name: 特殊技：灼热熟成法
fields.nameEn: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
fields.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:

向前方发动一次火焰冲击，造成火属性伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting Fire DMG;
Press and hold [Special Attack] to charge, boosting the move's power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
fields.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用单手喷射器持续喷射火焰，随后向前方直线范围发动一次火焰冲击，造成大量火属性伤害，保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长喷射的持续时间；
持续喷射期间拖曳摇杆，可以发动侧身闪避，向对应方向调整身位；
持续喷射期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低60%；
侧身闪避和火焰冲击发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the joystick to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 60%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot
fields.trigger: [强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]发动期间，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While using EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]发动期间，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用双手喷射器持续喷射火焰，随后向前方直线范围发动一次强力的火焰冲击，造成大量火属性伤害，保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长喷射的持续时间；
喷射发动瞬间和火焰冲击发动期间拥有无敌效果；
持续喷射期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低60%。
fields.descriptionEn:
While using EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive Fire DMG. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 60%.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:

Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。

fields.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

fields.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起，快速旋转前进并向周身喷射火焰，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。

Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 核心被动：燃油特调
fields.trigger: 柏妮思消耗能量值时，会为自身累积[燃点]，最多累积100点；每消耗1点能量值，能够累积1.4点[燃点]，当[燃点]累积至50点时，柏妮思将进入[燃油特调]状态，直到[燃点]耗尽；进入战场时，柏妮思立刻累积100点[燃点]；
fields.triggerEn: When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
fields.description:
柏妮思消耗能量值时，会为自身累积[燃点]，最多累积100点；每消耗1点能量值，能够累积1.4点[燃点]，当[燃点]累积至50点时，柏妮思将进入[燃油特调]状态，直到[燃点]耗尽；进入战场时，柏妮思立刻累积100点[燃点]；
[燃油特调]状态下，柏妮思的[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]、[连携技：燃油熔焰]或[终结技：纵享盛焰]命中敌人时，将对目标施加[灼伤]效果，直到柏妮思退出[燃油特调]状态；队伍中其他角色攻击命中处于[灼伤]状态下的敌人时，会触发[余烬]效果，消耗8点[燃点]，对目标造成等同于柏妮思350%攻击力的火属性伤害并累积火属性异常积蓄值，1.5秒内最多触发一次；每拥有10点异常精通，[余烬]效果造成的伤害提升1%，最多提升30%；[余烬]效果造成的伤害被视为[支援攻击]伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 350% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

fields.name: 额外能力：星火燎原
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
fields.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
柏妮思[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]命中敌人，或触发[余烬]效果时，招式累积的火属性异常积蓄值提升65%；队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[灼烧]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method or EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：灼热抛接法（潜能觉醒）
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Tossing Method (Potential Awakening)
fields.description:
拥有[流火]时，换入前场时发动：
队友触发12次[余烬]后，柏妮思获得一点[流火]，拥有[流火]时，柏妮思下一次换入前场时消耗一点[流火]自动发动该招式，该次入场视作以[快速支援]入场，[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]触发的[余烬]命中敌人时增加2次计数，拥有[流火]时不再增加计数，消耗[流火]时清空计数；
快速突进并越过敌人，向敌人发动一次火焰冲击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
招式重击命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次原属性异常480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24%的伤害；
[额外能力：星火燎原]的火属性异常积蓄值提升效果对该招式生效；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]。
fields.descriptionEn:
If Burnice has Emberflow, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger Afterburn 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of Emberflow. With Emberflow, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When Afterburn triggered by Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing Emberflow, the counter no longer increases. Consuming Emberflow clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The Fire Anomaly Buildup increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [EX Special Attack] to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

fields.name: 核心被动：燃油特调
fields.description:
柏妮思消耗能量值时，会为自身累积[燃点]，最多累积100点；每消耗1点能量值，能够累积1.4点[燃点]，当[燃点]累积至50点时，柏妮思将进入[燃油特调]状态，直到[燃点]耗尽；进入战场时，柏妮思立刻累积100点[燃点]；
[燃油特调]状态下，柏妮思的[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]、[连携技：燃油熔焰]或[终结技：纵享盛焰]命中敌人时，将对目标施加[灼伤]效果，直到柏妮思退出[燃油特调]状态；队伍中其他角色攻击命中处于[灼伤]状态下的敌人时，会触发[余烬]效果，消耗8点[燃点]，对目标造成等同于柏妮思350%攻击力的火属性伤害并累积火属性异常积蓄值，1.5秒内最多触发一次；每拥有10点异常精通，[余烬]效果造成的伤害提升1%，最多提升30%；[余烬]效果造成的伤害被视为[支援攻击]伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 350% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

fields.name: 额外能力：星火燎原
fields.description:
队伍中存在其他[异常]角色或与自身阵营相同的角色时触发：
柏妮思[普通攻击：炽焰搅拌式]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法]、[强化特殊技：灼热摇荡法·双份]命中敌人，或触发[余烬]效果时，招式累积的火属性异常积蓄值提升65%；队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[灼烧]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒。
